company_name: FELCON CLEAN ROOM TECHNOLOGY (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides cleanroom solutions and wet processing equipment essential for semiconductor fabrication environments.
summary: Felcon Clean Room Technology (India) Private Limited specializes in manufacturing equipment for wet processing and modular cleanroom construction, which are crucial for maintaining controlled environments in semiconductor fabrication. Their products include wet benches and the Felcon Double Walled Isolator, developed for stringent conditions required in specialized applications.
capabilities: Wet benches for manual, semi-automated, or automated processes
Felcon Double Walled Isolator for isolated and inert conditions

regional_presence.India: Felcon has established a strong presence across India, supplying cleanroom solutions and process technology to various clients, including the Indian Telephone Industries.
